newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain studies another budget adjustment by yr-end.
newsitem.headline: Spain studies another budget adjustment by yr-end.

text.p: Spain is considering another budget adjustment before year-end as Social Security revenues are now expected to fall short of previous expectations by 200 billion pesetas, according to a report citing the Budget Office director.
"Social Security will cut its deficits through loans, and the part that it cannot absorb will be absorbed by the Ministries," financial daily Expansion quoted director Jose Barea as saying.
But the newspaper also quoted the Secretary of the State for the budget, Jose Folgado, as saying "there was no concrete plan to adjust the budget."
Folgado added that the budget was monitored day by day but recognised there were problems at Social Security.
"But these can be compensated by good developments at the State and regions," the paper quoted Folgado as saying.
